section.title: Activity
section.para: The function \(W\) gives the temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit, of a pot of water on a stove, \(t\) minutes after the stove is turned on.

Take turns with your partner to explain the meaning of each statement in this situation. When it’s your partner’s turn, listen carefully to their interpretation. If you disagree, discuss your thinking and work to reach an agreement.

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature when the stove was turned on was 72 degrees Fahrenheit.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(0)=72\)

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature after 5 minutes was warmer than the temperature after 2 minutes.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(5)>W(2)\)

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature of the water after 10 minutes was 212 degrees Fahrenheit.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(10)=212\)

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature of the water was the same after 10 minutes and after 12 minutes.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(12)=W(10)\)

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature after 15 minutes was higher than the temperature after 30 minutes.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(15)>W(30)\)

div.para: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample: The temperature when the stove was turned on was lower than the temperature 30 minutes later.

list.item: What did you and your partner agree is the meaning of \(W(0)<W(30)\)
Sketch a possible graph of function W using the informaiton in the previous questions. If all statements in the previous question represent the situation, sketch a possible graph of function \(W\).

problem.para: When you have finished graphing, then select the solution button to compare your work.

image.alt: graph of temperature of water over time

div.para: Creativity is the ability to think of new solutions. When you approach life with a creative attitude, you are more open to new ideas and possibilities, better able to understand others’ perspectives, and more likely to seek out multiple solutions to problems.
Think about your current sense of creativity. Are the following statements are true for you?

list.item: I often seek out new experiences and ways of doing things.
I like to think of different ways to reach my goals.

div.para: Don’t worry if none of these statements are true for you. Developing this trait takes time. Your first step starts today!
